purpose: Focused post-review proof for semantics intentionally changed after the original frozen rubric.

criteria: Routes sparse pre-revenue capital-heavy work to managing-runway-and-survival because no completed survival/readiness handoff was supplied, while refusing software-seed, ramen-profitability, and weekly-evidence defaults.
Produces the cash-floor, dated technical/supplier readiness, protected-obligation, no-raise/delay, and exact capital re-entry handoff rather than launching or pricing a round.
Treats letters and discussions as zero cash/demand and requires qualified technical, finance, and legal owners without inventing professional conclusions.

Stops and corrects the false metric everywhere before company acceptance and makes deterministic selection depend on hard gates, anchored scores, frozen aggregation, and a unique winner rather than a preferred label.

Treats fund-signed offers as company-unaccepted and explicitly separates ZaR readiness, ZaE company acceptance evidence, ZcR definitive-document and funding readiness, and ZcE effective documents plus cleared funds.
Uses accept-selected-then-close, counter, continue, and decline/no-deal branches with tie and unresolved-evidence behavior; never calls acceptance itself closing.

Keeps capital primary and normalizes the SAFE, priced equity, and venture debt through applicable ownership/conversion, cash-service, warrant, covenant, lien, maturity, default, and control consequences with qualified owners.
Models milestone coverage and downside/base/upside cash and ownership effects, existing SAFE/pro-rata implications, and a no-deal or staged option without calling debt non-dilutive.

Treats weak-market commentary as claimed, uses only verified market evidence for cadence and counters, and applies hard gates, anchored scoring, aggregation, unique-winner/tie behavior, acceptance evidence, and later closing evidence.
